review_basis.method: Static inspection; only this new proposal file written.
review_basis.qualification_06_state_when_authored: running; no final result asserted here
review_basis.scope_limit: No qualification claim for all incoming files/models/launches/deployments; frozen sources unchanged.

repository_view.observed_contract: Retains included originals separately from compact text; original restore preserves bytes/directories/0777 permissions/relative symlinks.

python_view.observed_contract: Compact AST omits comments/formatting; unchanged AST retains original bytes. Changed unambiguous definitions require full-file SHA256 and syntax/span checks; whole-module edits refuse.
python_view.interpretation: Deterministic source-backed editing, not learned IR decoding/behavior proof. Retained originals enable reversible views without minifying canonical files.

published_generation_context_assets.facts: Original capture/materialization, native index joins and full source checks precede generation publication; stale/uncertain/failed states refuse or require refresh.

Reuses native.duckdb, CodebaseCatalog, RepositoryCodebaseIndex, DuckDBASTStore, DuckDBASTIngestor and immutable artifacts. No target import/execution; fresh is structural reconstruction, not decoder quality; opaque caches not natively indexed.
Exact root/state/capsule/source joins retain confidence/raw-source requirements; no omission safety, behavior equivalence or proof/execution/completion authority.
Full mandatory bodies/IDs/coverage, bounded optional handles, question-bound expansion and parent-bound deltas. Cooperative currentness fences are not writer leases.
Existing worker tools provide discovery/expansion, original/compact reads, expected-hash editing and refresh; no new capsule framework.

native_readmission_boundary.rule: View generation differs from native task/claim, grant, inventory and allocation. Edits/refresh cannot renew sealed joins. Independently re-admit current source/inventory/context under the appropriate native generation/capability; never relabel/rebind old grants.
native_readmission_boundary.consumer_checks: Check adapter/native currentness before render/dispatch and after asynchronous work. Selected/omitted drift refuses old authority; retain full-source/lifecycle fences.
native_readmission_boundary.separate_future_design: permission-handoff-design.json covers future permissions/delegation/cross-process admission; not implemented/duplicated here.

bounded_next_increment.name: Host-side generation-bound checked-proof references for existing repository contexts
bounded_next_increment.goal: Reuse checked proof evidence beside existing capsules through existing DuckDB/cache owners; no new DB/decoder/training/solver job for this bridge.
bounded_next_increment.proposed_input_contract: Original live host session/adapter/cache objects, expected generation and independently admitted typed obligation/full expected key. No worker-discovered DB, serialized capability or caller-minted correspondence.
bounded_next_increment.generation_join: Retain session/repository/generation/full source-tree/package-manifest/semantic-state/root/capsule-index identities. Join proof scope/premises to admitted source. Pin original objects/bytes; reject substitution/reentry. Recheck complete source/native lifecycle after CAS/clock/other callbacks and before render; repeat after asynchronous work. Stale/uncertain state refuses.
bounded_next_increment.hash_format_correspondence: Adapter uses sha256:<source_tree_sha256>; obligations may use Git-tree identity. Formats/scopes differ. Retain independently checked complete-source correspondence with both identities or decline reuse. Relabeling, selected paths/snippets or Boolean claims are insufficient.
bounded_next_increment.output_contract: Use RepositoryContextAdapter.compile(optional_evidence=...) and existing parent-bound expansion/retry. Preserve full mandatory task/acceptance/evidence bodies, assumptions/residuals/counterexamples/coverage. Miss/rejection/missing correspondence stays unresolved, not refuted/satisfied. No execution/completion authority.
bounded_next_increment.conditional_local_proofs: Retain typed local scope/premises/assumptions/residuals; conditional kernel proof cannot become flat whole-program satisfaction/completion. Incomplete-scope consumers refuse promotion. Native header admissions still require live revalidate_for_render/revalidate_for_commit; raw lookup/serialized accepted flags are insufficient.
proposed_qualification: Real checked cache hit/current generation; no models.
Selected/omitted drift, old generation, native lifecycle change, callback mutation/object substitution refuses.
Tree-format/scope mismatch or absent correspondence refuses.
Required conditions survive selection/expansion/retry; local proof cannot satisfy flat completion.
Complete bounded reference/expansion frames charged; caller cleanup retained.
bounded_next_increment.cache_gap: CodeProofQuery._annotate_cache does not lookup cache IDs without full keys; satisfied claim/digest handles alone do not authenticate current checked evidence.

ir_and_asset_separation.preservation_rule: Preserve assets/embeddings/checkpoints/inventories/DuckDB/DuckLake/Hugging Face identities by family/dimension/schema/task. No inventory collapse, incompatible head sharing, dimension relabeling or AST-as-autoencoder claim. No discovery/import/upload/distillation/quality claim here.
ir_and_asset_separation.future_training_rule: Later learned decoding/distillation retains asset lineage and separate byte-exact/semantic metrics; no training in this increment.

matched_complete_usage_plan.accounting_rules: Consistent cumulative snapshots; never sum repeated events or assume initial/interrupted baseline zero. Cached input is a subset, not extra input. Separate local counts/native usage/billing. Missing/inconsistent/nonmonotone usage or incomplete tool populations leave complete total unknown; observed completion is not verified billing.
matched_complete_usage_plan.comparison_rule: Compare matched success/reward/correctness/latency/full usage across repeated trials including failures. Initial context/bytes/isolated replies/cache hits/structural coverage cannot establish session savings, equivalent outcomes or model gains.
matched_complete_usage_plan.measurement_limits: Repository reply selection counts complete JSON-RPC plus newline with pinned local tokenizer; compact only for fewer tokens, else original. Local counts are not provider/session savings. Existing authored context experiment has no provider usage/official reward/complete multi-IR qualification.
